description.zh: 网络实例的类型。取值：**VBR**边界路由器实例。
description.en: The type of the network instance. Set the value to **VBR**.

description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate a token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** of the request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** of each API request may be different.

description.zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
- **true**：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。
- **false**（默认值）：发送正常请求。
description.en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

- **true**: Performs a dry run.

- **false** (default): Sends a normal request.

title.zh: 从专线网关（ECR）卸载子实例

descriptions.zh: 在调用**DetachExpressConnectRouterChildInstance**接口从专线网关卸载VBR实例之前，请确保专线网关的状态为**Active**。
descriptions.en: Before you call the **DetachExpressConnectRouterChildInstance** operation to detach a VBR from an ECR, ensure that the ECR is in the **Active** state.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun expressconnectrouter detach-express-connect-router-child-instance --ecr-id ecr-mezk2idmsd0vx20000 --child-instance-id vbr-j6cwxhgg0s5nuephp0000 --child-instance-type VBR --dry-run true --client-token 02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-000000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun expressconnectrouter DetachExpressConnectRouterChildInstance --region cn-hangzhou --ChildInstanceType VBR --EcrId 'ecr-mezk2idmsd0vx20000' --DryRun true --ClientToken '02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-000000' --ChildInstanceId 'vbr-j6cwxhgg0s5nuephp0000'
